vocabulary: Terra Firma, Robinhood Chain, wif (said 'wif'), nvda (said 'n-v-d-a'), pons (said 'ponz'), uniswap, chainlink, stock tokens, onchain, epoch

lines.text: this is a real wallet on robinhood chain.
it put thousands of dollars into memes, and almost all of it is gone.
if that same money had gone into nvda at the same moments, most of it would still be there.
i built terra firma because most of us have a number like that and never look.
it shows you yours, or anyone's, then helps you do something about it.
this is my own wallet on mainnet.
i buy a meme through uniswap like i normally would, and my card shows what i paid, what it's worth now, and what it would be in nvda.
that one isn't coming back, so i convert it.
two signatures, the meme is sold, and it lands in my jar as nvda stock tokens, priced against chainlink.
nobody has an admin key to the jar, so i can take it out whenever i want, and it keeps a saving streak.
people are always going to trade memes, so we might as well take advantage of that.
any meme buy or sell can keep a slice, up to ten percent, that lands in your jar as stock in the same transaction.
i buy pons with two percent, then sell some the same way.
this is where wif comes in.
every trade pays a half percent fee, and that money only ever buys wif, it never sells it.
if you stake wif, you get paid from every trade on the app in real stock, whichever one you pick.
i stake a hundred and pick nvda. new stakes wait a full epoch, so nobody can game a payout, and staking ten thousand drops your own fee to point three percent.
once an hour anyone can run the fee pool.
half of what it collected buys wif and burns it, and the other half buys stock for the stakers.
mine goes straight into my jar.
you can also mint your card, which burns one more wif after the contract checks the numbers against chainlink.
minted cards go on the leaderboard, next to the biggest jars.
so wif gets bought on every trade and burned every hour, and the people holding it get paid in stock.
it's on the proof page, and any card can be recomputed onchain, so you don't have to take my word for it.
it's for anyone trading memes on robinhood chain, and for wif holders who'd rather be paid in stock.
it only prices the memes it tracks, and it isn't profit and loss.
that's terra firma.
